motion_and_interactions.page_transition: framer-motion fade-in from bottom (y: 10, opacity: 0 -> y: 0, opacity: 1, duration: 0.4s)
motion_and_interactions.list_stagger: framer-motion stagger children (delay: 0.05s per item) on initial load
motion_and_interactions.image_load: blur-in effect on load (filter: blur(10px) -> blur(0px) over 0.5s)

hero.description: Minimalist high-contrast food presentation. Use as the main backdrop on the Homepage hero section with an overlay.

locations.description: High-end architectural photography to be used for the three location routing cards on the Homepage.

products.description: Appetizing food imagery for product seed data (Trending items, Location menus).

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 ratio for text. Use text-[#1A1A1A] for all body copy over the #FDFBF7 background.
accessibility_and_testing.data_testid_convention: All interactive elements MUST use data-testid. Examples: data-testid='terasa-location-card', data-testid='restaurant-location-card', data-testid='discoteca-location-card', data-testid='filter-pill-burger', data-testid='add-to-cart-button', data-testid='product-item-123'
accessibility_and_testing.touch_targets: All buttons, filter pills, and list items must be easily tappable on mobile devices (min 44px active area).

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the application using React and Tailwind CSS. Use Shadcn/UI for Admin dashboard components (Tables, Dialogs, Forms) where appropriate.
For the customer-facing mobile web menu, prioritize custom HTML/Tailwind over heavy Shadcn layout components. The mobile menu must feel like a native app (fluid, no horizontal overflow).
Implement theme switching (Terasa vs Restaurant) by toggling Tailwind classes dynamically or using CSS custom variables scoped to the location route.

Data structure involves: produse(nume, descriere, pret, imagine, categorie=terasa|restaurant|discoteca, subcategorie=mancare|bauturi, tip, vizualizari). Ensure 'tip' translates to the sticky pill filters.

Horizontal scrollable pill filters MUST hide the scrollbar. Add custom CSS: '.hide-scrollbar::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; } .hide-scrollbar { -ms-overflow-style: none; scrollbar-width: none; }'.
Use Phosphor Icons (or Lucide) for UI icons such as view counts, back buttons, and cart.
Import 'Cormorant Garamond' and 'Manrope' fonts from Google Fonts and configure them in tailwind.config.js as 'font-primary' and 'font-secondary'.
Ensure the Hero section on the homepage has the locations cards AND the trending products section as per requirements.
